title: IPCEnvelopeV1
description: The single framing for every trust-crossing message between the POLARIS desktop surface and the trusted native core. Three closed message shapes; there is no fourth and no open extension point.

Operation.title: Operation
Operation.description: Closed operation set. An arbitrary operation name is unrepresentable, not merely rejected at runtime. The five desktop.* members were added additively at 1.1 (ADR-017); the nineteen provider.*, model.*, project.* and context.* members were added additively at 1.2 (ADR-019); the ten mission.*, task.*, agent.*, claim.* and evidence.* members were added additively at 1.3 (ADR-021); the twelve skill.*, tool.*, mcp.* and approval.* members were added additively at 1.4 (ADR-023); the twelve memory.*, browser.session.*, computer.session.*, computer.window.* and computer.target.* members were added additively at 1.5 (ADR-025). The twenty-eight connector.*, usage.*, budget.*, pricing.*, observability.*, diagnostics.* and config.* members were added additively at 1.6 (ADR-026). The thirty-two workspace.*, attachment.*, artifact.*, execution.*, mission.model.set, schedule.*, oauth.*, voice.transcribe, share.*, publish.*, skill.package.*, device.* and integration.settings.set members were added additively at 1.7 (ADR-028), and the four conversation.* members were added additively at 1.7 later (ADR-029), and agent.catalog and mission.specialist.set later still (ADR-030). The set is no more open than it was at 1.0. The four provider.catalog, provider.credential.put, provider.custom.save and provider.custom.delete members were added additively at 1.7 later still (ADR-037). The ten web.search.*, mission.rating.set, mission.note.add, tool.approval.grants, tool.approval.grant.revoke and github.* members were added additively at 1.7 later still (ADR-042).
